author: kycrafft
body:
These are just some starting points for kits. Feel free to suggest changes and level placements

Cannon: 10 TNT, 2 redstone torches 
Abilities: none

Dragon: Bow and 16 arrows, fire protection 4 leather helmet 
Abilities: bow has flame 1 but only 16 durability

Knight: iron pants
Abilities: Permanent slowness 1 and resistance 1

Climber: 64 ladders, water bucket, 32 cobblestone
Abilities: none

Syphon: splash potion of instant damage
Abilities: each hit gives you regen 1 for 3 seconds (does not stack beyond 3 seconds)

Fisherman: Fishing rod, fish (named Stinky Fish)
Abilities: rod has in unbreaking 3, fish does nausea like in CTH
